Its electronic structure remains largely similar to that of pristine 2H-TaS$_2$, showing only a minor overall energy shift and lacking the $β$ feature, consistent with disrupted long-range Co ordering and modified orbital character near the Fermi level. We demonstrate that the $β$ feature arises from strong local correlations on the Co sites and requires long-range crystallographic order among intercalated Co atoms to maintain coherence. These results highlight the importance of strong electronic correlations in magnetically intercalated transition-metal dichalcogenides and provide a microscopic understanding of features not captured by conventional DFT+U.

Abstract

Fractonic continuity equation is shown to hold for arbitrary CP$^{N-1}$ fluid implying the conservation of the topological charge and the dipole moment. Inclusion of the Gilbert damping modifies the continuity equation, resulting in the violation of the dipole moment conservation but not of the topological charge. Thiele's equation for the CP$^{N-1}$ skyrmion follows from the modified continuity equation. The Girvin-MacDonald-Platzman (GMP) algebra in the long-wavelength limit is derived for arbitrary CP$^{N-1}$ fluid. In the case of CP$^2$ skyrmions, we identify stable skyrmions in which the ferromagnetic moments are dominant. One can associate a nonzero CP$^1$ charge equal to half the CP$^2$ skyrmion charge and argue that the topological Hall effect of electrons should exist due to their coupling to the ferromagnetic part of the CP$^2$ texture.

TL;DR: 该论文将自旋交叉材料的短程谐波弹性模型精确映射为包含幂律短程和无限长程Husimi-Temperley相互作用的Ising模型，并揭示了弹性挫败和长程相互作用的微观起源。
摘要翻译

自旋交叉（Spin crossover, SCO）材料是一类可逆分子开关，广泛存在于过渡金属配合物和金属有机框架（Metal organic frameworks, MOFs）中。它们表现出多样的自旋态有序结构及其之间的转变。在此，我们提出了从简谐弹性模型到Ising类模型的精确映射，该模型同时包含在大距离下呈幂律衰减的短程Ising相互作用，以及不依赖于距离的长程（无限程）Husimi-Temperley相互作用。我们将这一映射应用于SCO骨架的简单模型。这为Ising-Husimi-Temperley模型描述提供了微观依据，而此前该描述仅基于唯象理由。弹性阻挫是产生非零Ising相互作用所必需的，但Ising模型中短程相互作用是否具有几何阻挫，取决于体变模量与剪切模量之比，或等价地，取决于泊松比。长程相互作用有两个来源：（i）平均自旋态上的自相互作用，通过平均自旋态与晶胞参数之间的耦合来中介；（ii）自旋态-自旋态耦合中的红外发散，该耦合由晶胞内金属和配体的位移所中介。在没有弹性阻挫的情况下，这两项大小相等、方向相反，因此不存在长程相互作用。然而，在一般情况下它们并不抵消，因此存在长程Ising相互作用。该长程相互作用不依赖于金属中心之间的距离，但它对（自由）能具有广延贡献。在该模型中，Husimi-Temperley相互作用主导自旋态转变；因此，完整模型中仅发现单步转变。而如果仅保留纯（幂律）Ising相互作用，则会观察到多步转变和中间有序。

Abstract

Spin crossover (SCO) materials are reversible molecular switches found in a wide range of transition metal complexes and metal organic frameworks (MOFs). They exhibit diverse spin state orderings and transitions between them. Here we present an exact mapping from harmonic elastic models to Ising-like models with both a short-range Ising interaction that decays with a power law at large distances and a long-range (infinite-range) Husimi-Temperley interaction that is independent of distance. We apply this mapping to a simple model of SCO frameworks. This provides a microscopic justification for an Ising-Husimi-Temperley model description, which has previously only been justified on phenomenological grounds. Elastic frustration is required for non-zero Ising interactions, but whether or not the short-range interactions in the Ising model are geometrically frustrated depends on the ratio of the bulk and shear moduli, or equivalently Poisson's ratio. The long-range interaction has two origins: (i) a self-interaction on the average spin state, mediated through the coupling between the average spin state and the unit cell parameters; and (ii) an infrared divergence in the spin state-spin state coupling mediated by displacements of metals and ligands within the unit cell. %In the absence of elastic frustration these terms are equal and opposite so there is no long-range interaction. However, in general they do not cancel and there is a long-range Ising interaction. The long-range interaction is independent of the distance between metal centers, nevertheless it leads to an extensive contribution to the (free) energy. In this model the Husimi-Temperley interaction dominates transitions of spin states, whereas multistep transitions and intermediate order are observed if only the pure (power-law) Ising interaction are retained, only single-step transitions are found in the full model.

Abstract

The pursuit of geometrically frustrated lattices beyond conventional paradigms remains a central challenge in the design of quantum materials. Herein, we report the discovery of the A3V9Te13 (A = Cs, Rb) family of vanadium-based intermetallic compounds, which host a unique two-dimensional Mosaic lattice derived from the Kagome network, composed of an ordered tessellation of triangles, squares, and pentagons. The Cs compound (CVT) exhibits strong electronic correlations, characterized by non-Fermi liquid behavior at low temperatures, an exceptionally large Sommerfeld coefficient, and a bulk phase transition at T* $\approx$ 47 K with possible charge- or spin-related origin. Inspired by pressure-tuning in related Kagome systems, we demonstrate that the electronic ground state of this lattice is exquisitely tunable via chemical pressure. Systematic substitution of Cs with smaller Rb ions suppresses the T* phase transition and the correlated electronic response, ultimately driving the system into a highly frustrated semiconducting ground state without long-range magnetic order down to 60 mK. This work unveils a new structural platform for exploring the interplay between geometric frustration and strong electron correlations, providing a chemically controllable platform for exploring the phase space between distinct correlated electronic states.

摘要翻译

我们报道了偶极-八极（dipolar-octupolar）烧绿石 Ce₂Sn₂O₇ 的漫散射测量，以阐明其在其有序温度 T_N ~ 40 mK 以上的关联顺磁区内的磁关联。近期比热测量中观察到的 T_N 处磁相变，在最近邻 XYZ 模型中被解释为进入全进全出（all-in-all-out, AIAO）磁有序。然而，在 T_N 以上观察到的漫散射不支持 AIAO 磁有序，因为在 AIAO 波矢处没有观察到短程序，这与最近邻模型不一致。相反，观察到的漫散射与经典偶极自旋冰（classical dipolar spin ice）Dy₂Ti₂O₇ 中观察到的漫散射非常相似，并表明在 Ce₂Sn₂O₇ 的低能流形中，存在由更远邻相互作用所支持的短程关联结构，如链或团簇。我们讨论了链状态如何定性地解释在 [1,1,0] 磁场下的 H-T 相图。

The magnetic transition at $\mathrm{T_N}$, observed in recent specific heat measurements, has been interpreted within the nearest-neighbor XYZ model as a transition into an all-in-all-out (AIAO) magnetic order. However, the observed diffuse scattering above $\mathrm{T_N}$ argues against an AIAO magnetic order by exhibiting $no$ short-range order at the AIAO wave-vectors, inconsistent with the nearest neighbor model. Instead, the observed diffuse scattering strongly resembles that observed in classical dipolar spin ice, Dy$_2$Ti$_2$O$_7$, and suggests the presence of short-range correlated structures such as chains, or clusters in the low energy manifold of Ce$_2$Sn$_2$O$_7$, favored by further neighbor interactions. We discuss how chain-like states qualitatively account for the observed H-T phase diagram under a [1,1,0]-field.

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种多参考GW（MR-GW）图解方法，从相互作用活性空间参考出发结合动力学屏蔽处理强关联分子，改进单粒子激发和卫星结构描述。
摘要翻译

GW近似（GW approximation）是多体微扰理论中计算单粒子激发的基石，但在强关联体系中，由于单参考图像不再适用，它可能在定性上失效。为克服这一局限，我们从相互作用的活性空间参考态出发，发展了一条通往多参考GW（multi-reference GW，MR-GW）的图解途径：对强关联进行非微扰处理，并通过多参考随机相位近似（multi-reference random phase approximation）层面的动态屏蔽来处理剩余相互作用。由于常规的图解自能展开不再适用，我们在广义图解框架内定义了一种实用的单次（one-shot）MR-GW近似，并将标准GW作为特例还原出来。将该方法用于典型强关联原子和分子的结果表明，相互作用的活性空间参考能够捕捉到单参考GW难以描述的多组态卫星结构，而动态屏蔽通常还会改善卫星能量以及主要电离能和电子附着能。本工作为同时结合非微扰强关联与动态屏蔽的格林函数方法开辟了一条图解路线。

Abstract

The GW approximation is a cornerstone of many-body perturbation theory for computing single-particle excitations, yet it can fail qualitatively in strongly correlated systems where the single-reference picture becomes inadequate. To overcome this limitation, we develop a diagrammatic route to multi-reference GW (MR-GW) from an interacting active-space reference, treating strong correlation nonperturbatively and the residual interaction through dynamical screening at the multi-reference random phase approximation level. Because the conventional diagrammatic self-energy expansion no longer applies, we define a practical one-shot MR-GW approximation within a generalized diagrammatic framework, recovering standard GW as a special case. Applications to prototypical correlated atoms and molecules show that the interacting active-space reference captures multiconfigurational satellite structures poorly described by single-reference GW, while dynamical screening generally improves the satellite energies as well as the leading ionization and electron-attachment energies. This work opens a diagrammatic route to Green's-function methods that combine nonperturbative strong correlation with dynamical screening.

TL;DR: 该论文通过超快泵浦-探测光谱研究了过掺杂单层铜氧化物Pb-Bi-2201的光诱导反射率动力学，发现弛豫时间在赝能隙端点附近呈幂律发散，暗示量子临界行为。
摘要翻译

利用光学超快时间分辨泵浦-探测光谱技术，我们对重度过掺杂的单层铜氧化物超导体(Bi,Pb)$_{2}$Sr$_{2}$CuO$_{6+δ}$(Pb-Bi-2201)在赝隙和超导相端点附近的瞬态反射率动力学进行了系统研究。在所提出的赝隙端点掺杂浓度附近的Pb-Bi-2201中，高于$T_{\rm c}$时的瞬态反射率动力学与最佳掺杂La-Bi-2201中观察到的赝隙响应相似。然而，随着温度降低，弛豫时间表现出幂律发散行为，$τ\sim10\hbar/k_{\mathrm{B}}T$，这与所提出的赝隙端点掺杂附近存在的量子临界行为一致。在略微更过掺杂的成分中也观察到类似的弛豫时间幂律增加，但该效应相对不明显。

Abstract

A comprehensive study of photoinduced transient reflectivity dynamics in heavily overdoped single-layer cuprate (Bi,Pb)$_{2}$Sr$_{2}$CuO$_{6+δ}$ (Pb-Bi-2201) across the end points of the pseudogap and superconducting phases was conducted using optical ultrafast time-resolved pump-probe spectroscopy. In the Pb-Bi-2201 near the proposed pseudogap end-point doping, the transient reflectivity dynamics above $T_{\rm c}$ resemble the pseudogap response observed in the optimally doped La-Bi-2201. With decreasing temperature, however, the relaxation time exhibits a power-law divergence, $τ\sim10\hbar/k_{\mathrm{B}}T$, consistent with quantum critical behavior near the proposed pseudogap end-point doping. A similar power-law increase in relaxation time is also observed at a slightly more overdoped composition, though it is less pronounced.
